projects.description: 留服认证专业复核的保姆级攻略。作者毕业于香港城市大学理学硕士（电子商贸）项目，拿到教育部留学服务中心的初次认证结果后申请专业领域复核，把认证专业从“电子商贸”改成了“计算机科学与技术（电子商贸）”。仓库整理了这次复核的完整流程、全套申请材料模板和准备思路。

en.name: Guide for Professional Review of the China Academic Degrees and Graduate Education Development Center's Certification (City University of Hong Kong MScEC → Computer Science and Technology)
en.description: A nanny-level guide for professional review of the China Academic Degrees and Graduate Education Development Center Certification. The author graduated from the Master of Science (E-commerce) program at City University of Hong Kong. After obtaining the initial certification result from the Ministry of Education's China Academic Degrees and Graduate Education Development Center, he applied for a professional field review and changed the certified major from "E-commerce" to "Computer Science and Technology (E-commerce)". The warehouse has sorted out the complete process of this review, the full set of application material templates and the preparation ideas.
en.about: A Nanny-level guide for adding first-level disciplines to the review of the China Academic Degrees and Graduate Education Development Center's certification! This project shares that the author successfully conducted a professional field review after completing the academic degree certification by the Ministry of Education's China Academic Degrees and Graduate Education Development Center (CSDC). The complete experience, application material template and methodology for re-evaluating the Master of Science in Electronic Commerce (MSc) of City University of Hong Kong to the Master of Science in Computer Science and Technology (E-commerce). It aims to assist students with similar needs (especially the younger students of the MScEC program at City University of Hong Kong and those from other overseas institutions who wish to add a first-level discipline) to successfully complete the professional review.

projects.name: extend-slides
projects.author: lowen
projects.about: 把课程课件/讲义/录音转写扩展成可独立复习的中文讲解文档，解决平时学习/期末复习难题
projects.description: 一个帮助同学将教授【过于简略的课件】转换为【可系统地、全方位地学习的知识手册】的技能，同时为了尽最大可能还原课堂内容，此技能并不会重构知识结构，而会保留原有的课件脉络，只增添智能讲解。为了适配不同的学科，这里有四个模式可使用，分别对应计算证明类/例题导向类/应用类/理论推理类的课程。

en.name: extend-slides
en.description: A skill that helps students convert professors' oversimplified courseware into knowledge manuals that can be systematically and comprehensively learned. At the same time, in order to restore the content of the classroom as much as possible, this skill will not reconstruct the knowledge structure, but will retain the original courseware context and only add intelligent explanations. In order to adapt to different disciplines, there are four models that can be used, corresponding to the courses of the computational proof class/example-oriented class/application class/theoretical reasoning class.
en.about: Expand the transcriptions of course courseware, lecture notes, and audio recordings into independently review Chinese explanatory documents to solve the problems of regular study and final review

en.name: MentorMatch · Mentor Matching Assistant
en.description: 🏹 applying for a doctoral program? MentorMatch is a desktop application for students to select their mentors. Just input your resume or research plan, and choose whether it's a master's or doctoral student. It will pick a batch of candidate mentors from CSRankings, calculate the matching degree one by one, and finally rank them by score, telling you who to email first.
en.about: Upload your resume/RP and get a one-click match with a global mentor
